# BB00405 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Subduer of all things, the All-Attracting, the All-Glorious, the All-Powerful.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belong the subtleties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a light tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all power, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a power tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the purity of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a purity tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the dust of the first and of the last, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a dust tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Point in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Point tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the grace of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a grace tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord, and He, verily, is my Sufficiency; He will assuredly aid me, by His command, at all times, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belong the subtleties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the singleness of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a oneness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Alif in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of an Alif tremendous.

Say: God is the Creator of all things, through His command, "Be", and it is.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of might, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the splendour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a splendour tremendous.

Unto God belong the Most Excellent Names, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Name tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guardianship in its fulness, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Ba' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Ba' tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of greatness in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the bounty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a bounty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the certitude of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a certitude tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Kingdom (malakút) tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Jim in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Jim tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belong the subtleties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the perpetuity of judgement, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a lasting judgement tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God it pertaineth that, from every soul, there be nineteen days wherein it serveth the Point and acteth by Her leave; and God hath ever been the Possessor of a grace tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of power, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord, in the beginning and in the end; in Him have I put my trust, and sufficient is God as a Sovereign, tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of sovereignty, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guidance in its fulness, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guidance tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guardianship in its fulness, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.
